title: Taco Paneer Quesadilla
description: A twist on the classic quesadilla with Indian-inspired paneer cheese and Peruvian flavors.
instructions: 1. Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. In a bowl, crumble the paneer and mix with aji amarillo sauce.
3. Place a flour tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with the paneer mixture.
4. Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
5. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the filling is heated through.
6. Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
7. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling.
8. Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve with sour cream and cilantro.
9. Garnish with queso fresco, if desired.
